patterns.name: RuntimeError Factory Function Message Classification
patterns.root_cause: Factory functions createValidationError, createAuthError, etc. accept message parameter and pass to RuntimeError constructor without classifying the message first. The message could be raw, unvetted input.
patterns.unsafe_render_path: RuntimeError constructor → Error.message → potential exposure if error object is serialized or logged
patterns.current_pattern: export function createValidationError(message: string, context: RuntimeErrorContext, ...): RuntimeError { return new RuntimeError(message, {...}); }
patterns.notes: All 12 factory functions in runtime-errors.ts follow the same pattern. Single batch fix can resolve all 12.

patterns.name: Custom Error Class Throw with Unclassified Message
patterns.root_cause: Services throw custom error classes (NotFoundError, ValidationError, ConflictError, etc.) with unclassified message strings. The messages could be raw from user input, DB results, or external services.
patterns.unsafe_render_path: throw new CustomError(rawMessage) → Error.message → exposure if error is logged, serialized, or reaches operator
patterns.notes: Distributed across 16 service files. Batch by similar error class patterns to parallelize fixes.

batch_1.approach: Single file, 12 factory functions. Add classification to each function. replace_all safe within function bodies.

batch_2.approach: Fix throw Error(...) statements by adding getSafeErrorMessage wrapper or classifyOperatorError

batch_3.approach: Update custom error class constructors or call sites
